environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate but behind CloudFront distribution with custom response headers policy 'Managed-SecurityHeadersPolicy' (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d6-5758f4f180cf) which enforces strict CSP including script-src 'self' and blocks inline scripts. Additionally, the ECS task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with only /app/uploads and /app/extracted mounted as ephemeral tmpfs volumes (2GB max). The /app/public/assets directory resides on the read-only root filesystem layer baked into the container image at build time. The task IAM role has no S3 or EFS permissions. Container runs as non-root uid 1001 with Linux capabilities dropped via cap_drop: ALL in the task definition.

config.csp_enforcement: CloudFront overrides any application CSP with stricter policy
config.task_role: no S3/EFS permissions, minimal execution role
